purpose: Render development docs from a finalized state that uses persistence.
constraints: Keep persistence guidance explicit and migration-ready.

product.problemStatement: Development-mode rendering should cover persistence-enabled projects too.
product.whyNow: The migration-policy branch should be protected by regression tests.
product.expectedValue: Persistent projects render the right docs and keep `.gitignore` stable.
product.solutionSummary: Use a finalized-state fixture with SQLite persistence to test migration-policy rendering.
product.mvpScope: Render development docs and validate the persistence-specific outputs.
product.assumptions: The development templates already include database ignore patterns.
product.nonGoals: Duplicate ignore rules during repeated renders.

governance.keyDecisions: Treat persistence as a first-class render branch with dedicated regression coverage.
governance.topRisks: Migration policy output or `.gitignore` drift silently when persistence is enabled.
governance.mitigationPlans: Keep a persistence-enabled fixture in the main render test suite.
governance.contingencies: Refresh the fixture when persistence rules evolve intentionally.
governance.remainingAcceptedRisks: Template wording may still evolve over time.
